purpose: Single targeted A/B for Order 188 after the untouched baseline found extension.install only through search but the legacy nested params wrapper repeatedly produced a string instead of executable parameters.
change_scope: Make extension.install an Adapter-owned direct contract. The model selects an exact Marketplace identifier or local VSIX path, source_type, and optional force flag unchanged. The Adapter reads public VSIX package metadata to derive the installed identity when needed, executes the standard VS Code CLI, and verifies the resulting extension list. Add generic install, extension, local, Marketplace, and VSIX retrieval terms. Legacy source fields remain internal compatibility only. No task identity, fixed path, expected extension ID, golden value, instruction parser, evaluator access, Runner argument rewrite, or parameter injection is added.

protocol.runner_guard_terminal_semantics: Internal guard termination records the reason and invokes the original evaluator without appending OSWorld FAIL; explicit model fail_task remains OSWorld FAIL.
protocol.on_failure: Preserve and audit this single generic hypothesis. If it does not pass, mark Order 188 task_blocked immediately and advance to Order 189. Do not add a fixed VSIX path, expected extension identity, task-local parser, GUI sequence, Runner argument injection, or unchanged rerun.

counterfactual_contracts.input: Install an alternate local linter VSIX whose manifest names a different publisher and extension, with force disabled.
counterfactual_contracts.expected: The model-selected path and source type reach the Adapter unchanged; the Adapter derives the identity from package metadata, omits the force flag, installs, and verifies CLI state.

counterfactual_contracts.input: Install redhat.vscode-yaml from the Marketplace with force enabled.
counterfactual_contracts.expected: The Adapter uses the exact model-selected Marketplace identifier for both installation and post-action verification.
The model-selected source, source_type, and force flag reach extension.install unchanged.

implementation_evidence.focused_tests: 692 passed across VS Code Adapter, schema, verifier, strict manifest, catalog, and Runtime boundary tests
implementation_evidence.real_cache_metadata_probe: A generic parser invocation derived the installed identity from the untouched local OSWorld VSIX cache without using evaluator expected state.

selection.method: one targeted A/B for Order 188 generic hypothesis 1 under the short per-task budget
